author: Anjali Sharma
comment: Absolutely magical! The luxury Swiss tents were extremely clean and cozy. Trekking to Hemkund Sahib was challenging but coming back to hot garlic soup and cozy bedding at Ghangaria was pure heaven.

author: Rohan Mehra
comment: Best camping service in Ghangaria. The naturalist guide knew every single flower species in the valley. If you are going, choose their Swiss tents, they are worth every rupee.

author: Priya Patel
comment: The Eco Camp was amazing. Very clean composting toilets and very delicious local food. Highly recommend for environmental travelers looking to minimize footprint.

author: Amit Verma
comment: Excellent coordination and very safe layout. We had elderly members in our group and the staff made sure they got a pony ride. The food felt like home-cooked meals.
